mapping.source_purpose: Acts as central coordinator: receives incoming requests, formulates a high-level plan of tasks, delegates them to specialized agents, and aggregates their outputs into a final response.
mapping.note: Coordination of goal-directed execution without owning execution mechanisms.

mapping.source_purpose: Domain-focused experts, each responsible for a distinct area of expertise; may themselves coordinate sub-agents.
mapping.note: Instantiated only in multi-agent configurations; the ESG case uses a single coordinating agent.

mapping.source_purpose: Centralized data service cataloguing each agent's identity, capabilities, operational status, version and metadata tags, enabling discovery and auditability.
mapping.note: Agent discovery; distinct from the L6 tool registry, which catalogues executable capabilities rather than agents.

mapping.source_purpose: Request-based communication for tightly coupled or latency-sensitive interaction; message-driven communication via a broker or event bus for loose coupling and resilience.
mapping.note: Coordination ownership remains in L3 while the message-driven variant is mediated by L7; the architecture separates these, the source groups them under one element.

mapping.source_purpose: Holds what is true of this user, session and collaboration -- preferences, decisions, open issues, interaction history. The source states explicitly that memory is not a knowledge base: enterprise content is authoritative, shared, permission-controlled and changes independently of any conversation.
mapping.note: The source independently draws invariant I2: session-scoped state is distinguished from enterprise knowledge retrieved on demand through a permission-trimmed index.

mapping.source_purpose: Designing, preparing and managing the information supplied to models to shape behaviour and results.
Identity enforcement with agents and orchestrators authenticating via an identity provider and RBAC governing execution permissions; policy-controlled tool invocation at the point of action.
mapping.note: The source independently draws invariant I3: boundary identity enforcement is separated from authorization at the point of action.

mapping.source_purpose: Assessment of system behaviour and quality.
Responsible-AI policies and accountability structures, guardrails across the AI lifecycle, governed data access and use, evaluation and red-teaming processes.
mapping.note: Policies and accountability are design-time L0 decisions, while runtime guardrails (content safety, prompt shields) are L2 boundary controls.
